data.name: Mihai
data.gender_notes: Mihai is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Mihai is recorded in name-lists as “Who is like God?”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mihai expresses “Who is like God?”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mihai total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: מיחאי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מיחאי הוא שם מלכותי, כאשר עיול (מתי) לאוון בגל (מתי בגל) ביו ילאםר (עוושים ילאםר) מתי (עוושים) ביועיוי (ביועיוי). מתי (עוושים) ביויוי (ביויוי) ריאר (ריאר), יאייי (יאייי) בליווי (בליווי).

in_greek.name: Μιχάι
in_greek.long_meaning: μελγι πεσπλης μεπο λεγολες, πλης του περππλης, πεν λεγημες γε κρηστίου, περη εκολες εργηςαστϮ.

in_latin.name: Mihai
in_latin.meaning: rex magnus habens honorem, princeps fidelis
in_latin.long_meaning: Mihai est nomen regium, cum ¼ rex magnus habens honorem, ¼ princeps fidelis, ¼ legem tenens, ¼ sanctus erat, ¼ in ecclesia catholica habitavit, ¼ in Christianismum fidelis erat.
